caption: The drawing is presented on a beige background and depicts a furniture piece labeled "CARD TABLE" in black ink at the lower right, with the name "Henry Meyers" also written below. The table has six straight legs and a uniquely shaped tabletop composed of two semicircular ends joined by a symmetrical, indented central section, forming a shape resembling a rounded “W.” Surrounding the table, there are black lines indicating measurements: the width is marked as 39 inches, the depth as 17 inches, the apron or skirt height as 5 inches, and the total table height as 29 inches. Above the legs, the table features a curved apron following the contours of the tabletop. At the bottom center of the page, the scale is noted as “1/8". There are no colors besides the black ink of the line drawing, measurements, and text, all set against the light beige color of the paper.
title: Card Table
